1	# Repair inconsistent cross-protocol Osprey validation reports
2	
3	A spectroscopy group is validating a historical Osprey snapshot with
4	deterministic checkpoints derived from one synthetic phantom study. All runs
5	complete and produce finite values, but two independent report panels are not
6	compatible across supported acquisition configurations:
7	
8	- a model-derived contribution changes substantially between edited
9	  acquisition encodings that represent the same calibration;
10	- a downstream quantitative result changes substantially between acquisition
11	  settings prepared to represent the same control.
12	
13	Run the public reproduction, inspect the project source, checkpoints, and data
14	structures, and repair the scientific
15	implementation. A valid repair must preserve legitimate dependence on sequence
16	design, basis content, fitted signals, acquisition metadata, field strength,
17	and supported correction models.
18	
19	Do not hard-code the visible records, replace either report with a fixed value,
20	or edit generated outputs.
